name: George Harrison
description: 1965 年 Beatles 动画风格的 George Harrison，蓝色外套、深色高领，安静而专注。.
character_notes: Use the supplied Beatles 1965 George Harrison references. Preserve narrow angular face, long straight pointed nose, heavy brows, dark mop hair and pointed nape tufts, slightly stooped slim body, blue jacket and matching blue trousers, dark navy turtleneck, black shoes. Flat cel animation, no guitar or added props. Preserve original mature cartoon proportions, not chibi. Screen-direction looks use head pitch/yaw with torso and feet anchored.
